name: Dracula
description: Palette anchors for dsh-dracula-theme. Colors and the canvas/brand token mappings are adopted from the official Dracula DeepSeek port (github.com/dracula/deepseek, MIT) — the same --dsw-static-* token vocabulary the DSH Web theme runtime uses. Edit anchors here, then run `npm run generate`.

soft.description: Dracula Soft: a slightly lighter, gentler background variant (official soft background #343746).

canvasRamp.description: --dsw-static-neutral-bluish-* overrides from the official port, verbatim. Semantic comments from the source: 950 base bg, 900 sidebar fill, 875 layer-1, 850 layer-2 + code block bg, 800 layer-3/cards/overlays, 750 tooltips/selector, 700 borders & muted, 600 captions, 300 secondary labels, 400 tertiary labels, 50 primary text.

brandRamp.description: --dsw-static-deepseek-* overrides from the official port. 400 link / brand-text → cyan, 450 brand-primary → purple, 500 hover.

codeTokens.description: The official Prism token mapping, translated to the DSH shiki vocabulary: comments #6272a4, punctuation #f8f8f2, tags/parameters/this → cyan, numbers/constants/strings/inserted → yellow, keywords/operators/builtins/regex → pink, functions → green, deleted/important → red.

grayRamp.description: Anchor stops of the neutral grayscale ramp (--dsw-static-neutral-*), lightest (00) to darkest (1000). The official port does not override this ramp; values are Dracula-gray interpolations for a self-contained theme.
